Title: Kiss of Ra/ Red Herring Question?

Messages.Author: Jason Liang
Messages.Body:
So I am playing Ravnos, and some vampire is attempting to block an action
(such as Army of Rats). I play Kiss of Ra at superior, which says "... and
the action is now blocked." What happens when I play Red Herring at
inferior, which says "Only usable when this acting vampire is blocked. Untap
the acting vampire, do not tap the blocking minion, and cancel the current
action and combat. Take the card played to perform the action (if any) back
into your hand."

Am I correct in assuming that this play is legal, the blocking minion is
sent into torpor (tapped if Red Herring is at superior), the Army of Rats I
played goes back into my hand, my acting minion is sent into torpor untapped
and can perform say Rapid Healing to get out of torpor?

Cheers,

Janus, Childe of Chronus
5th Generation True Brujah

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <9sqmk7$s7r$1...@agate.berkeley.edu>, Jason Liang

<jli...@uclink4.berkeley.edu> writes:
>What happens when I play Red Herring at
>inferior, which says "Only usable when this acting vampire is blocked. Untap
>the acting vampire, do not tap the blocking minion, and cancel the current
>action and combat. Take the card played to perform the action (if any) back
>into your hand."

Kiss of Ra has blocked the action; Red Herring wants a blocking minion.

Messages.Author: Frederick Scott
Messages.Body:
James Coupe wrote:
>
> In message <9sqmk7$s7r$1...@agate.berkeley.edu>, Jason Liang
> <jli...@uclink4.berkeley.edu> writes:
> >What happens when I play Red Herring at
> >inferior, which says "Only usable when this acting vampire is blocked. Untap
> >the acting vampire, do not tap the blocking minion, and cancel the current
> >action and combat. Take the card played to perform the action (if any) back
> >into your hand."
>
> Kiss of Ra has blocked the action; Red Herring wants a blocking minion.

I don't understand this answer. Obviously, there is a "blocking minion" (per
card text on Kiss of Ra), so that isn't the issue. Are you saying that because
the card text on Red Herring refers to a "blocking minion" that it is therefore
illegal to play because Kiss of Ra blocked the action? I would have otherwise
assumed that you either simply ignore the "do not tap the blocking minion" part
of RH or apply it to the minion on which KoR had been played.

Fred

There is no blocking minion after Kiss of Ra, since the action is blocked by
Kiss of Ra (prior to the would-be blocker's block attempt being successful).

> the card text on Red Herring refers to a "blocking minion" that it is therefore
> illegal to play because Kiss of Ra blocked the action? I would have otherwise

Yes.

> assumed that you either simply ignore the "do not tap the blocking minion" part
> of RH or apply it to the minion on which KoR had been played.

No. See also Change of Target. [LSJ 24-FEB-1998]
